summary: Implemented the governed TypeScript backend as a long-running Railway API with private PostgreSQL persistence, a shared bounded scheduler cycle, signed provider callbacks, and explicit failure-safe external action handling.

commands: npm run build:server && npm run test:server
tests.notes: The server build/typecheck passed; 28 focused server, contract, and FHIR tests passed; all governed contracts validated; and six vendor-neutral migration tests passed. Tests cover the health/tick trust boundaries, scheduler non-overlap, idempotency/version guards, caregiver minimization, external-action controls, Twilio signatures, official ElevenLabs post-call/failure envelopes, callback deduplication, and transcript non-persistence.

notes_for_next_agent: Configure the Railway api service to use railway/api.toml, the repository root as build context, one replica, sleeping disabled, and DATABASE_URL=${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}.

The process listens on 0.0.0.0:$PORT, exposes database-backed GET /health, runs the same WorkflowApplication.tick cycle from the internal scheduler and authenticated manual endpoint, and waits for an active tick before closing PostgreSQL on SIGTERM/SIGINT.

Provider intent is committed before network I/O. Unknown network outcomes become outcome_unknown and are excluded from blind re-claim; signed callbacks reconcile stored attempts by provider conversation/message reference.

ElevenLabs callbacks accept the official signed post_call_transcription and call_initiation_failure envelopes, derive scenario/correlation only from stored provider attempts, return HTTP 200, and persist neither transcript nor audio.

Keep EXTERNAL_ACTIONS_ENABLED, TWILIO_SMS_ENABLED, and ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ENABLED false until Railway variables, fixed recipient, exact public origin, and signed callback preflight pass. No live provider action was performed by this worker.
